rows.description: Microservices on .NET platforms used ASP.NET Web API, Docker, RabbitMQ, MassTransit, Grpc, Yarp API Gateway, PostgreSQL, Redis, SQLite, SqlServer, Marten, Entity Framework Core, CQRS, MediatR, DDD, Vertical and Clean Architecture implementation with using latest features of .NET 8 and C# 12

Now upgraded to .NET 9, this project is a super-fast, completely headless API powered by Clean Architecture, CQRS, and MediatR. It includes an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages implementation for inventory order management, combined with Vue.js for a dynamic, responsive UI. Powerful WMS solution.
